projects.name: Odessa Facility
projects.quote: Our largest data center is the Odessa Facility which is our wholly-owned 207 MW facility located in Odessa, Texas.

projects.name: Alborz facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Bear facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Chief facility
projects.quote: We also operate our Alborz, Bear and Chief facilities in different sites across Texas pursuant to a joint venture with WindHQ where we have a 49% membership interest in each facility.

projects.name: Luminant Power Agreement
projects.quote: Cost of revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022 was $0.7 million and consisted primarily of power costs at the Odessa Facility under the Luminant Power Agreement.

projects.name: Combined Luminant Lease Agreement
projects.quote: Financing for use of the land and substation is provided by Luminant affiliates, with monthly installments of principal and interest due over a five-year period starting upon transfer of legal title of the substation to us (estimated total undiscounted principal payments of $15.0 million).

projects.name: Bitmain S19j Pro miner purchase agreement
projects.quote: Under our agreement of August 2021 with Bitmain, we purchased a total of 27,000 S19j Pro miners, at an average price of $49.66 per terahash.
